projects.name: RMRF
projects.text: Capture the flag on a three.js island: four vehicles, towers, mines and an AI commander that plans its own missions. My biggest project.

projects.name: Valehex
projects.text: Build a world together: make a private lobby, agree on the rules, and take turns exploring and founding settlements.

projects.name: Montana
projects.text: Paradise Valley in Montana, built from real terrain.

projects.name: Shipwrecked
projects.text: This is a survival game that starts you on a shipwrecked island. It generates the terrain based off of a seed which allows lots of possibilities.

projects.name: Ant Farm
projects.text: A colony digging its nest in a tank of sand, from one queen to galleries full of brood and food. Click to drop food.

projects.name: Boxing
projects.text: Stephen versus a chimpanzee. Watch its tell, dodge, then hit back. Round two brings a warrior bug that cannot be beaten.

projects.name: Gem Tower Defense
projects.text: This game lets you build walls and choose gem towers. Then enemies come out and use the A-Star path-finding algorithm to work their way through your maze (unfinished).

projects.name: Earth Model
projects.text: An Earth model based on height and satalite maps from NASA.

projects.name: South Park Math
projects.text: Pick a South Park character and walk to the right answer. The UFO beams up the correct one; get it wrong and it takes you.

projects.name: Dino Math
projects.text: Run around as a T-Rex and eat the correct numbers.

projects.name: Lunar Lander Math
projects.text: Land on the right answer without coming down too hard.

projects.name: Snowboarding Math
projects.text: Steer the snowboarder through the right equations and skip the wrong ones. Avoid the trees.

projects.name: Math Murder
projects.text: Kill the robot with the right answer on its face before it gets you.

projects.name: Lander
projects.text: Try to land on the moon surface without crashing. Then try to make it back up to the lander without running out of fuel! Also from the JavaScript Tutorial.

projects.name: Missile Defense
projects.text: This might bring back some memories. Try to save the cities for as long as you can. The code is designed to be readable for the JavaScript Tutorial.

projects.name: Space Game
projects.text: A game that is actually complete. You try to save the pods in the asteroid field.

projects.name: Mazes
projects.text: Three mazes in one page: a 2D maze solved with A*, my first 3D with no libraries, and a three.js walk through a gallery of pictures.

projects.name: Spin 3D
projects.text: A custom build 3D engine is used to spin 100 points to the front from 1 to 100.

projects.name: Kid Game
projects.text: An incomplete application that allows easy development for simple games.

projects.name: Settlers
projects.text: A 2D Settlers game that I almost finished and then decided to rewrite it. Then it never was finished.

projects.name: Jeopardy
projects.text: This Jeopardy game is loaded with Linux questions, but you can easily edit the JSON data to customize it.

projects.name: Sound Lab
projects.text: A modular synth in the browser: patch cables, custom waves, a song editor, and the game's own sounds.

projects.name: Asset Designer
projects.text: Builds and polishes the buildings and props that go on RMRF maps.

projects.name: Home Designer
projects.text: Draw a house floor by floor - outline, walls, windows, doors, stairs, roofs - and walk through it in 3D. Built for the Montana terrain.

projects.name: Model Lab
projects.text: Every model on the site in one viewer, in sections: Jacob, the station kit, trees, the bugs, Shipwrecked and the 2019 site. Orbit it, play its animations, take it apart into parts.

projects.name: Noise Gallery
projects.text: The noises the textures are built from, side by side: value, simplex, cellular, ridged, and the ways they stack.

projects.name: Fire Lab
projects.text: Volumetric fire on a shader: the flame profile, the noise that churns it, lean and colour, tuned live. Came from RMRF, where the wrecks burn with it.

projects.name: Shield Lab
projects.text: The force-field bubble: hex grid, rim glow, flashing cells, rings where it is hit, blue to red as it drains. The town's fence and RMRF's vehicle shields share it.

projects.name: Grass Lab
projects.text: Blades by the thousand with wind: cone, spike, flat, billboard or a curved bezier blade; colour gradient and variety; unlit against the ground. Came from RMRF.

projects.name: Tree Lab
projects.text: A forest drawn two ways: real meshes near the camera, octahedral imposters beyond a line you set, crossfading through a band. The imposter atlases are baked in the page from the same trees. Sliders for how many trees, the atlas grid and the blend; readouts for the cost.

projects.name: HTML/JavaScript/Canvas Game Tutorial
projects.text: This is a tutorial to get someone started with simple game programming using JavaScript.

projects.name: The old site
projects.text: jacobconrads.com as it was in 2019: a spinning 3D cube of projects, with a plain version behind it.

projects.name: Shipwrecked Demo Page
projects.text: This page breaks down some of the features of the Shipwrecked game. It includes demonstrations of the 3D models. Click the grid to make them walk. Try to drag and rotate.

projects.name: Effects Page
projects.text: An collecting of effects that are just for fun. Press a key to cycle through them. Many of them respond to mouse movement.

projects.name: Recursive Artwork
projects.text: This program can generate some interesting artwork with a simple recursive algorithm.

projects.name: Color Fun
projects.text: This little app was made for my kids and lets you mix colors to see the result. You can stir around in a color to get more of it. Works on mobile.

projects.name: A-Star Algorithm Demo
projects.text: A great demonstration of the A-Star path-finding algorithm. Generates random maps and Gives controls to see detailed information.

projects.name: 2D Grid over 3D Globe
projects.text: Project from back in the day trying to wrap a 2D map over a 3D Sphere with a no libraries or anything.

projects.name: UI Concept
projects.text: This is the result of playing around with a recursive menu idea.

projects.name: Subnetting Calculator
projects.text: This app helps you learn subnetting by asking questions and calculating answers.

projects.name: Periodic Wave
projects.text: A synth built on the Web Audio createPeriodicWave call: shape a wave and play it.

projects.name: Dots
projects.text: A hundred dots drifting and bouncing around the screen.

projects.name: Dragon
projects.text: A class assignment: a dragon drawn with hand-written 2D affine transforms (rotate, scale, translate).

projects.name: House
projects.text: A house model in three.js that you can orbit around.

projects.name: Land Builder
projects.text: A canvas experiment toward building land.

projects.name: Matrix
projects.text: Falling columns of characters, like the Matrix.

projects.name: Mortgage Calculator
projects.text: Monthly payment, total interest, taxes, insurance and HOA for a home loan, with a graph.

projects.name: Mouse Tracking
projects.text: A canvas that turns to follow the mouse.

projects.name: Neural Activity
projects.text: Neurons connected by lines, with signals firing between them.

projects.name: UI Sketch
projects.text: A canvas interface sketch.

projects.name: US Height Map
projects.text: The United States raised from a height map.
